Since the system natural frequency depends on the equivalent stiffness, the system natural frequency also varies correspondingly.

The reason for this phenomenon is due to the difference of the longitudinal equivalent stiffness of the ballasted bed, the longitudinal equivalent stiffness of the ballasted bed in Case 1 and Case 3 is 2 × 106 kN/mm and 2 × 106 kN/mm, respectively, and the minimum of which in Case 2 is 2 × 106 kN/mm.
